    SerpentRoyale

    Ten snakes. One shrinking ring. Grow big enough to swallow the rest.

    SKIN
    How to play
    • Eat fruit to grow. Bananas, grapes, watermelons and golden apples are worth the most.
    • Green names are much smaller than you. Touch them to swallow them whole.
    • Red names can swallow you. Bumping into any snake that big or close to your size costs you length.
    • Stay inside the ring. The last snake wins.

    Mouse to steer. Hold click or Space to boost (costs length). WASD or arrow keys also steer.

    Terms & Privacy

    Terms of Service

    1. By playing Battle Snake Warm, you agree to follow these terms.
    2. You must be 13+ to play. Players under 18 need parental consent.
    3. Cheating, hacking, or exploiting bugs will result in a permanent ban.
    4. All in-game purchases are demo-only — no real money is charged in this version.
    5. Account data is stored locally on your device. Clearing browser data will reset progress.
    6. The developer reserves the right to update these terms at any time.

    Privacy Policy

    1. We do not collect personal data in this version. All data (coins, skins, settings) is stored in your browser's localStorage.
    2. No account registration is required — your UID is auto-generated.
    3. No analytics or tracking is enabled in this build.
    4. If you connect a payment provider for real purchases, their privacy policy will apply separately.
    5. Friend invites use share links — no contact data is accessed without your action.

    Refund Policy

    Since all purchases in this version are demo-only (no real payment), no refunds are needed. If you connect real payments in a future update, refunds will follow the platform's standard policy (Google Play / App Store).
